title: viburnum ferrugineum
intro: Viburnum ferrugineum, commonly known as Rusty-leafed Viburnum, is a flowering plant species within the Adoxaceae family. It is a shrub that offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for wound healing, skin issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum ferrugineum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Viburnum ferrugineum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
